content: You can't go back and change the beginning, but you can start where you are and change the ending.
author: C.S. Lewis
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. True art and creative work are not about clever technique; they demand total emotional skin in the game. When you create safely to please an audience or avoid criticism, the work feels hollow and bloodless.

C.S. Lewis understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Pouring your genuine spirit, vulnerability, and raw lived experience into what you make is what gives it enduring life. The work that resonates across centuries is always the work created with unapologetic personal truth.
reflectionPrompt: What would happen if you met today's stress with steady acceptance rather than resistance?
